community.evidence: making the world a better place to live

safety.evidence: committed to safe and efficient operations and products

innovation.evidence: We are busy developing the big ideas and broad solutions we will need to achieve net zero.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with mostly absolute language ('we won't stop until we're there', 'We dare to do what others won't'). Environmental and society-facing claims dominate the opening; shareholder performance appears mainly as value slogans. Little on customers, workforce wellbeing, or DEI. Distinctive wording: 'reaching for the impossible', 'Commit to good'.
